newsitem.title: BRAZIL: Brazil's Fipe inflation 0.68 pct Jan 8-Feb 7.
newsitem.headline: Brazil's Fipe inflation 0.68 pct Jan 8-Feb 7.

text.p: Brazil's inflation as measured by the Economic Research Institute (Fipe) dropped to 0.68 percent between January 8 and February 7 versus 1.23 percent in January, a Fipe official said.
Fipe inflation index coordinator Juarez Rizzieri said price rises in the last four week period had been held back by a significant drop in clothing prices.
He said he expected inflation for the whole of February to be around 0.3 percent.
Rizzieri released the following breakdown of Fipe's weighted inflation index for January 8 through February 7:
- Food: 1.01 pct rise in the month
- Housing: 0.32 pct rise in the month
- Transportation: 1.36 pct rise in the month
- Personal expenses: 0.84 pct rise in the month
- Clothing: -3.13 pct drop in the month
- Health care: 0.42 pct rise in the month
- Education: 6.67 pct rise in the month
The Fipe index is calculated by the University of Sao Paulo, which releases inflation figures weekly.
